    VLLM_SERVED_NAME="${MODEL_NAME}-base"

    --vllm-port "$PORT" \

    print(f"Baseline: completion={bl.get('task_completion_rate',0):.1%}, politeness={bl.get('mean_politeness_rate',0):.3f}")

def start_vllm_server(

) -> subprocess.Popen:
